summary: Iteration 23 (backend + frontend) on the live-auth build. Created an OWNER session (owner.qa@emergent.sh, users.role=owner + owner_invites) and a REVIEWER session (vishal.k@emergent.sh, role=member, 18 assignments) directly in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md. Backend: 17/17 pytest checks passed in test_iter23_reviewer_edit_and_team.py — /api/auth/me 401 without token, correct role for each session, /roles/me is_owner true/false, reviewer 403 on /roles/owners + /known-emails, reviewer assignments scoped to 18 slugs; reviewer PUT on an assigned doc (put-your-app-live) => 200 with reviewer_edited_by='vishal.k@emergent.sh' persisted, reviewer PUT on an unassigned doc => 403 'You can only edit pages assigned to you for review' with content untouched, reviewer PUT cannot flip status to published (field filtered), owner PUT clears reviewer_edited_by/at to null, reviewer 403 on publish, still 121 docs / 0 published. Roles: owner GET /roles/owners contains sarang@emergent.sh (no _id leak), reviewer POST /roles/promote => 403, owner promote => 200 and email appears in owners. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL, cookie auth): /review/put-your-app-live as OWNER shows reviewpage-edit-btn + reviewpage-open-editor-btn; Edit reveals reviewpage-edit-title/content/save/cancel/open-editor-inline; Save draft persisted the markdown and toasted 'Saved as draft — an owner can publish it'; Cancel closes the editor; 'Full editor' navigated to /admin/editor/<pid>/<docId>. Publish tab shows the 'Edited by reviewer' badge (edited-by-reviewer-f8320b81-...) with title 'Edited by vishal.k@emergent.sh' — exactly 1 badge for the 1 marked doc. Team tab (owner) lists Owners (sarang + owner.qa) and 3 'Make owner' buttons; clicking make-owner-vishal.k@emergent.sh accepted the confirm, POSTed /roles/promote, moved the chip into Owners and toasted 'vishal.k@emergent.sh is now an Owner'. Reviewer session at /admin/review renders ONLY 'My Reviews' (review-tab-assignments) — overview/inbox/publish/team absent, header badge 'Reviewer'; reviewer inline edit + restore worked on their assigned page and the Edit/Full-editor buttons are absent on a non-assigned page. FOUND: 3 missing owner gates on document/config mutations (see critical). ALL DATA RESTORED: 121 docs, 0 published, 0 reviewer_edited_by, 52 assignments, owner_invites = [sarang@emergent.sh] only, all qa_sess_ sessions and qa test users deleted.

critical.issue: NO owner gate — a reviewer (role=member) session deleted a real document (what-is-emergent) and the handler also pruned its slug from the navigation config. Reproduced twice (200 OK). Data loss risk; a reviewer can wipe any of the 121 pages. I restored the document + nav entry (see rca).
NO owner gate — reviewer session created a new document (200). Should be 403 for non-owners.

NO owner gate — reviewer session can rewrite site config / whole navigation tree (200). The reviewer reaches this surface directly: 'Full editor' on the review page opens the full owner Editor with the nav tree, New Tab, Configurations, Version History and Export all.

minor.issue: ReviewConsole calls this owner-only endpoint for reviewer sessions too -> two 403s per load (console errors); the Delegate email autocomplete silently degrades to a plain input.

On every protected page load with a valid session cookie the first 2-3 calls return 401 (console 'AxiosError') before identical retries succeed. Cookie auth via curl is 200/200/200 consistently, so this is a frontend double-mount/credential-timing issue, not a server bug. Cosmetic but noisy and could flash an unauthenticated state.

integration_issues.issue: A reviewer clicking reviewpage-open-editor-btn lands in the complete owner Editor (full navigation tree for all 121 docs, New Tab, per-page ... menus, Configurations, Version History, Export all, Assist). Content PUTs on non-assigned pages are correctly 403'd, but doc create/delete and config PUT are not (see backend critical). Either gate those endpoints or open a reviewer-scoped editor view.

action_items: Add ensure_owner()/owner checks to POST /projects/{pid}/documents, DELETE /projects/{pid}/documents/{docId} and PUT /projects/{pid}/config (reviewers currently get 200 on all three).
Consider restricting the reviewer 'Full editor' entry point (or the Editor's owner-only controls) now that reviewers can reach /admin/editor.
Skip GET /known-emails in ReviewConsole for non-owner sessions to stop the 403 console noise.
Investigate the 2-3 initial 401s on /api/auth/me and /api/roles/me per protected page load (valid cookie present; retries succeed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_document is correctly gated, but the sibling mutating routes (create/delete document, PUT config, POST versions/restore-ish) rely only on get_current_user + project access, so the new reviewer role is effectively an editor with delete rights. Gate by role centrally rather than per-route.

delete_document also mutates project_configs navigation; combined with the missing owner gate this makes a single reviewer request destructive and non-recoverable (no version rows existed for the deleted doc).
GET /projects/{pid}/documents returns all 121 docs to reviewers; the review UI only needs the assigned subset — consider scoping for non-owners.

success_rate.backend: 81% (17/21 — 17/17 feature tests pass, 3/4 privilege probes reveal missing owner gates)

seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo rows only: user owner.qa@emergent.sh (role owner) + owner_invites entry, a users row for vishal.k@emergent.sh, two qa_sess_* sessions, one promoted owner_invite for qa.promote.test@emergent.sh and one for vishal.k (both removed). ALL deleted. Doc content for put-your-app-live restored byte-identical; what-is-emergent re-inserted after the reviewer-delete probe.
test_credentials: No passwords (Google OAuth). Sessions were created in Mongo per /app/auth_testing.md; run `python /app/backend/tests/iter23_setup.py` from /app/backend to mint fresh owner/reviewer tokens (written to /app/test_reports/iter23_state.json), and `python /app/backend/tests/iter23_cleanup.py` afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use iter23_setup.py / iter23_cleanup.py for session lifecycle (tokens land in /app/test_reports/iter23_state.json, which also snapshots the two docs used). Reviewer-edit + Team/promote + role-based tabs are all verified working. The open items are the missing owner gates (create/delete document, PUT config). WARNING: never point a delete probe at a real document — DELETE has no owner gate and also prunes the nav entry; test_iter23_reviewer_privilege_surface.py now uses an owner-created throwaway doc. what-is-emergent (id c83eef51-7f8c-40e6-b9d3-823edbfbb798) was re-inserted with reconstructed order=0 / icon='book' / description='What is Emergent?' and re-added as the first page of Build > Introduction — verify against intent if those metadata fields matter.
rca_of_the_issue: update_document is the only document route with a role check. DELETE /projects/{pid}/documents/{docId} (server.py ~725) and POST /projects/{pid}/documents (~614) plus PUT /projects/{pid}/config (~902) only call get_project_with_admin_check, which validates project access, not the owner role. Repro: with a role='member' session token, `curl -X DELETE $API/api/projects/<pid>/documents/<docId>` returns 200 and the doc plus its navigation entry are gone (no version history to roll back). Mitigation applied for the data: document + nav entry restored from the pre-test snapshot; fix required is ensure_owner() on those three routes.
